extracted.intended_audience: emerging writers, literary professionals, and general readers seeking information about the Whiting Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of the Whiting Awards: who they honor, categories, nomination and selection procedures, and related Literary Magazine Prizes. Useful for prospective nominees, nominators, and researchers of literary awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award purpose / eligibility (emerging writers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Achievement by emerging writers in fiction, nonfiction, poetry, and drama.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Whiting Award is an American award presented annually to ten emerging writers in fiction, nonfiction, poetry and drama. (Article states winners receive US$50,000 as of 2021.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Categories (genre eligibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fiction, nonfiction, poetry, and drama are the award categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Winners are chosen across these four categories; the historical winners list is organized by category and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of winners and frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: Presented annually to ten emerging writers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The award has been presented since 1985; as of the page, ten winners are selected each year and (as of 2021) each receives US$50,000.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nomination process (juried selection of nominees)
rubrics_metrics.description: The nominees are chosen through a juried process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are not self-submitted but are identified via a juried process (the page does not detail the jurors or nomination mechanics beyond this phrase).

rubrics_metrics.name: Final selection (committee composition)
rubrics_metrics.description: The final winners are selected by a committee of writers, scholars, and editors, selected each year by the Foundation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is committee-based; committee members are themselves writers, scholars, and editors appointed annually by the Whiting Foundation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application/nomination restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Writers cannot apply for the prize themselves, and the Foundation does not accept unsolicited nominations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility/entry is restricted to those nominated through the Foundation's processes; direct applications or unsolicited nominations are not considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literary Magazine Prizes (separate magazine awards and eligibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: Since 2018, the foundation has also awarded Literary Magazine Prizes to US-based nonprofit publications whose audience is adult readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize-winning magazines are invited to work with the Foundation over three years and receive outright grants of $10,000–$20,000 in the first year followed by matching grants in the second and third years.
